This is the CORRECT handling of Single; the census's 15 wrong units are the ones that override on_stack to `pass` (`py audit/tools/power_census.py stack`). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterDeath.rationale: RE-EXECUTED 2026-07-30: re-read CrabRagePower.cs and the current sim class side by side, and every claim this entry's own prose already made checks out with nothing left over. Constants match (STRENGTH_GAIN=6 / BLOCK_GAIN=99, powers.py:2941-2942, vs CrabRagePower.cs:25-29's PowerVar<StrengthPower>(6m) / BlockVar(99m, Unpowered)), the Block grant carries `props=VP.UNPOWERED` (powers.py:2951), the guard order matches (`creature is self.owner or creature.side != self.owner.side: return`, powers.py:2946, the De Morgan complement of CrabRagePower.cs:33's `creature != base.Owner && creature.Side == base.Owner.Side`), and the effect order matches (Strength, then Block, then `self._expire()`, powers.py:2950-2952). Both sides still lack an IsDead guard, so a dead-but-retained arm still rages in both models -- a faithfully-reproduced asymmetry, not a bug. THIS HOOK MAPPING HAS NO DIVERGENCE OF ITS OWN: the entry's own closing sentence already said 'the gap is the missing applier= on the Strength grant, below' -- pointing at guards[0] (mechanism power/crab_rage/g1), a separate JSON node with its own verdict. Filing this hook as `gap` duplicated that one finding under two mechanism ids with nothing new at this one, so it is corrected to `faithful` here; guards[0] carries the real (dormant) finding, settled in the same pass below.

guards.issue: MISSING `applier=`. C# passes `base.Owner` (`PowerCmd.Apply<StrengthPower>(choiceContext, base.Owner, ..., base.Owner, null)`); the sim omits it, so `applier` is None through hooks.modify_power_amount (cmds.py:297), hooks.on_power_applied (cmds.py:327) and hooks.on_power_amount_changed (cmds.py:312), and the granted power's .applier is left None (powers.py:59). Recurring gap shape 5. DORMANT, executed: the sim's applier readers are RitualPower.__init__ (powers.py:195), _PossessPower._track (powers.py:3092-3099 -- needs `applier is self.owner` AND a player target AND a negative delta), UnsettlingLamp (relics/unsettling_lamp.py:47 -- needs `applier is self.player`) and the `creature is self.applier` on_death tests of shrink/constrict/dampen/hex; none matches an enemy self-buff with a positive delta. Reproduce with `py audit/tools/power_slot_probes.py applier-readers`. Same verdict as power/high_voltage's and power/territorial's (rule 3). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

guards.rationale: monsters/hive/kaiser_crab.py:47 and :116 both apply it, matching Crusher.cs and Rocket.cs. The `creature != base.Owner` guard is what stops the dying arm raging itself, and it is present on both sides.
